about: One answer of the Foundry agent strata-criteria-reader, written by hand in the Responses API's shape: text that names bidders in a tender still open and asks which one qualifies. Replace it with a recording: uv run --script ops/agent/record.py --env-file .env --criteria
question: Bids for KE-MIGORI COUNTY-532367-CW-RFB closed last week. Mwangaza Builders Ltd listed two similar contracts and Pwani Works Ltd listed one. Which bidder qualifies under our similar experience requirement, and who is likely to win?
